coverage: Named roster (SRD 5.1 and SRD 5.2.1) fetched raw as PDFs and measured in full; nothing in the named roster was not found or blocked. 13 sources read, 12 substantive: 5 primaries/vendor documents fetched direct (both SRD PDFs, the WotC SRD page and its 5.2 FAQ, the official conversion guide, the 2018 Basic Rules PDF), 4 by bibliography chasing off the SRD page and its FAQ (the two D&D Beyond studio posts, the conversion guide, the forum thread), 3 by lateral search (Merwin on boxed text, the ScreenRant designer interview, Dungeon Master's Workshop), 1 as an extraction control (5thsrd.org); Tribality read and rejected as a verbatim reprint of the WotC FAQ; no peer-reviewed stylometric study of the SRD exists — two searches returned only general stylometry literature, and that thin literature is itself the finding. The SRD contains no read-aloud text, no settlement tables and no civic-record vocabulary, so the measured place corpus is small by nature: 1,530 words in SRD 5.1 Appendix PH-C plus 550 words of pantheon prose, both of which SRD 5.2.1 deletes.
